# Vendored DocBook specification

`spec.txt` is *DocBook 5.2: The Definitive Guide*, the normative reference for the DocBook XML
vocabulary, published at <https://tdg.docbook.org/tdg/5.2/>. It is authored by Norman Walsh, edited
by Richard Hamilton, and copyright © 2010–2024 Norman Walsh (portions © 1999–2010 O'Reilly Media,
Inc.). The guide is distributed under the
[GNU Free Documentation License](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/fdl-1.1), Version 1.1 or
any later version, which permits redistribution and modification; the license text is reproduced in
`LICENSE` (and, as the guide's own Appendix E, inside `spec.txt`).

`VERSION` records the guide's edition, `5.2.19` (dated 13 September 2024), which documents the
DocBook V5.2 schema. The guide carries its own version number independent of the schema release it
describes.

It is vendored here as a public format specification — an allowed source of truth for this
clean-room implementation — to document the element vocabulary, content models, attributes, and
processing expectations the DocBook reader parses and the DocBook writer emits. The embedded markup
examples are used as **inputs** only; expected conversion output is regenerated by the pinned oracle
binary, never taken from the guide's rendered examples.

## What was rendered

The guide is published as a multi-page HTML site with no single-file edition, so `spec.txt` is a
plain-text rendering of that site: all 458 pages concatenated in reading order, each introduced by a
`[file.html] Title` banner. The guide's wording is unaltered. Only presentation differs: navigation
bars, stylesheets, and scripts are dropped; the line-number gutters of the example listings are
stripped so the DocBook examples read as source; and the content-model pattern groups that the HTML
edition hides behind expand/collapse controls are inlined as parenthesized element lists. `spec.txt`
opens with a header repeating the source URL, authorship, copyright, and license notice, as the
GNU FDL requires of a modified copy.

## Refreshing

To refresh or re-pin: re-fetch the page set from the guide's table of contents at the source URL
above, re-render it to text the same way, and update `spec.txt`, the version in this file, and
`VERSION`. Replace `LICENSE` if the guide's license appendix changes. Note that `tdg.docbook.org`
also publishes a newer `5.2.1` tree; this pin deliberately tracks the `5.2` one.
